summary: CNB Financial Corporation filed an 8-K solely to announce a routine quarterly cash dividend on its Series A Preferred Stock and associated depositary shares, with a $0.4453125 per depositary share distribution. No special-situation transaction, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change is involved. The filing is a standard current report on dividend declaration, not a special situation.
